name: Label
description: Radix Label with peer-disabled styling. The htmlFor association is what makes a form usable — not decoration.
intent: Names a control, and makes its text a click target for it.

authority.note: src/ is authoritative. If this contract disagrees with the source, implement from the source and report the drift.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Clicking the label focuses or toggles the associated control
notes: A label without htmlFor is decorative text and provides no accessible name.
Radix Label prevents text selection on double-click, which stops accidental selection when toggling a checkbox.

forbiddenUsage: Asterisk as the only required indicator
agentRules: htmlFor is mandatory. A Label without it is a bug.
Do not use Label for headings.
Required-field markers need text or aria-required, not an asterisk alone.
